title: Hierarchical Change Signature Analysis: A Framework for Online Discrimination of Incipient Faults and Benign Drifts in Industrial Time Series

contributions.purpose: 在线区分工业时序中的良性漂移与初期故障,避免把故障吸收为新'正常'
contributions.mechanism: 分层框架解耦change detection与characterization,漂移触发后在主检测器潜空间生成Multi-Scale Change Signature(MSCS)量化几何/统计变换
contributions.evaluation: 定性:MSCS架构(shallow/deep/residual)均收敛到高F1,residual收敛更快(无绝对数值)
contributions.source_quote: This work introduces a hierarchical framework that decouples change detection from change characterization. Upon detecting a drift, the system generates a Multi-Scale Change Signature (MSCS)...

contributions.purpose: 对漂移进行benign/fault分类并可持续演化
contributions.mechanism: 无监督Drift Characterization Module(DCM)基于Online Normality Baseline(ONB)在线分类,良性追加进ONB、疑似故障交人工复核(tiered human-in-the-loop)
contributions.evaluation: 定性:在TEP上较naive频繁重训减少误报(未给数字)
contributions.source_quote: An unsupervised Drift Characterization Module (DCM), trained on an Online Normality Baseline (ONB), classifies the signature as benign or a potential fault.

contributions.purpose: 诚实揭示框架的核心失效模式(负结果)
contributions.mechanism: 在Tennessee Eastman Process注入渐进故障与良性漂移做实验并做风险分析
contributions.evaluation: 核心假设被推翻:subtle/缓变故障不产生足够大潜空间位移而漏检,大幅良性配置改动又生成类故障签名致误报
contributions.source_quote: certain pitfalls persist, particularly when benign shifts produce unexpectedly large latent changes or when faults evolve subtly.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our framework builds on these ideas by introducing a structured way to isolate suspicious drifts, consult domain experts when needed, and then incorporate benign drift patterns back into the baseline for future reference.

notes: AI披露checklist全部[D]。明确负结果/trade-off:作者自认核心假设'faults induce substantially distinct latent manifolds'在实验中不成立(subtle faults漏检、benign大改动误报);检测灵敏度与稳定性之间存在阈值trade-off。数据红旗:全篇无数值结果表,'reduce false alarms'等结论仅靠图1/图2曲线趋势支撑,无量化对比。desk-reject。
